blocks.content: Maharashtra declared snakebite a notifiable disease on 18 August 2026 under the state public health framework. The order makes reporting mandatory for government hospitals, private hospitals, medical colleges, and healthcare practitioners for every suspected, probable, or confirmed case and death.

items: Snakebite is treated as a public health and emergency medicine issue in India because envenomation can cause death within hours.
Health Management Information System is a digital platform used for health data collection and monitoring in India.
Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme is India’s disease surveillance system for tracking and reporting health events.
Anti-Snake Venom is the only specific treatment for snakebite envenomation in many cases.
